sloka: इति उक्त्वा मृगशावाक्षीम् अलात सदृश ईक्षणा ।अभ्यधावत् सुसंक्रुद्धा महा उल्का रोहिणीम् इव ॥३-१८-१७॥
transliteration: iti uktvā mṛgaśāvākṣīm alāta sadṛśa īkṣaṇā ।abhyadhāvat susaṁkruddhā mahā ulkā rohiṇīm iva ॥3-18-17॥

translations.english: While speaking this, Surpanakha, with eyes like flaming amber ran to the fawneyed Sita in great anger like a giant meteor hurtling towards the constellation of Rohini :
